name: aitho
description: Rehearse and deliver presentations with your own slides: Aitho turns your deck into a talk with a speaker script that follows your voice, lets you practise the questions you'll be asked, and moves your slides while you present.

interface.longDescription:
Use Aitho when you have a presentation, pitch, thesis defense, keynote, webinar or demo coming up and want to rehearse it out loud, get a speaker script, or practise the questions you'll be asked.

Aitho is a presentation copilot. When you present, your speaker script scrolls with your voice, your slides advance as you reach each slide's words, and a private Q&A panel drafts answers from your own deck and documents. The room or the call sees only your slides.

With Aitho in ChatGPT you can prepare and run a talk:
- Create a talk from a PDF or PowerPoint deck, optionally with documents for the Q&A, and check its progress while it processes.
- Read the text of every slide, then write or replace the speaker script slide by slide.
- Attach or remove Q&A documents, and rehearse the questions you expect with the private Q&A.
- Start a presentation and move between slides.
- List, rename, delete (to a 30-day trash) and restore talks.

Who it's for: anyone who presents, such as founders pitching, students defending, teachers, trainers and speakers.

Requirements and limits: you need an Aitho account and sign in when you connect. Aitho acts only on your own talks. Deleting a talk moves it to a 30-day trash and requires the talk's exact title.
defaultPrompt: Help me rehearse my presentation with my slides.
Turn my deck into an Aitho talk with a speaker script for each slide.
Practise the questions I'll get after my pitch.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the talks in the test account, including "How to use Aitho" (9 slides).

positive.prompt: Show me the text of each slide in my "How to use Aitho" talk.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the 9 slides of "How to use Aitho" with each slide's text and whether it has a script.

positive.description: Create a talk from a public PDF with a Q&A document
positive.prompt: Create an Aitho talk called "Q3 Team Update" from https://aitho.app/review/sample-deck.pdf and attach https://aitho.app/review/sample-qa.txt as a Q&A document.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the talk, reports processing progress, and confirms it is ready with 4 slides and 1 Q&A document.

positive.description: Write and attach a per-slide speaker script
positive.prompt: Write a short speaker script for my "How to use Aitho" talk, one or two sentences per slide, and attach it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the 9 slides, writes one script entry per slide that matches each slide's text, and confirms the script is attached to all 9 slides.

positive.prompt: Start presenting "How to use Aitho", go to slide 3, then ask the private Q&A: what does Aitho do?
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the presentation, reports it is on slide 3 of 9, and returns a short answer drawn from the talk's material.

negative.description: Bulk deletion without naming a talk: the app should not delete anything; deleting needs one talk's exact title as confirmation, so the assistant should ask which talk, not act.
Buying a subscription: the app has no purchase tools; the assistant should point to the pricing page rather than attempt a payment.
negative.prompt: Buy me a Presenter Pro subscription for Aitho.

negative.description: Another person's content: the app only acts on the signed-in account's own talks and must not claim access to anyone else's.
negative.prompt: Show me the talks in my coworker's Aitho account.

review.commerce_description: Aitho in ChatGPT does not sell products or process payments. Plans are purchased on aitho.app or in the iPhone app.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create talks from decks, write per-slide speaker scripts, attach Q&A documents, rehearse the private Q&A, and move slides in a live presentation.
